additive.title: Ƙarin kaya da masu launi
additive.lead: Masu launi da masu hana haske ratsawa (opacifiers) da ake aunawa a kan girke-girken tushe, kamar cobalt ko tin oxide. Girke-girke zai iya barin su daga unity formula ko ya ƙidaya su a ciki.
